_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker create-logo --spec <file>`. Fill every empty field; keys starting with `_` are stripped before the spec is sent to the image model.
The output MUST stay a single seamless 4×4 grid of 16 app icons — the CLI slices it into cells afterwards, so grid_layout and the slicing rules must not be changed.
Customize core_visual_language and style_themes to the app's brand; keep exactly 16 entries in style_themes (one per cell, left→right, top→bottom).
Icons are logo marks: no text labels, no UI mockups, no photos.

grid_layout.arrangement: A single seamless image: 4 rows × 4 columns of rounded-square iOS app icons, one unique design per cell, equal spacing, icons never touch or overlap.
grid_layout.background: dark neutral, uniform and solid, presentation-ready
grid_layout.slicing_rules: spacing and alignment must be precise and identical across all rows and columns; each icon fully contained within its cell

applies_to_all: colorful with gradients and subtle lighting
